desc: A four-plan pricing section with a sliding monthly/yearly switch.

Installation

ProRequires a Planes Pro license.
npx shadcn add @useplanes/pricing-section

Works once the @useplanes registry is set up in your project (one-time). After that, copy and run commands directly.

$99 once · 160 Pro components · lifetime updates.

I have a licenseGet Pro
import { PricingSection } from "@/components/ui/PricingSection";

<PricingSection
  defaultBilling="yearly"
  yearlyBadge="1 month free"
  plans={[
    {
      id: "pro",
      name: "Pro",
      description: "For teams shipping together.",
      tiers: [{ label: "100 credits", monthly: 25, yearly: 23 }],
      cta: "Get started",
      highlighted: true,
      features: [{ label: "All Free features", strong: true }, "Custom domains"],
    },
  ]}
  onSelect={(plan, billing, tier) => checkout(plan.id, billing, tier)}
/>

Use cases

  • SaaS pricing page

    Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise side by side with an annual discount.

  • Usage-based plans

    Credit or seat tiers per plan, where the select drives the price.

  • Contact-sales tier

    An enterprise card with a platform-fee label and a demo CTA instead of a number.
